notes.title: ZPlague V1.7.0.0

tags.feature: Now we have a single-player mode where each chapter you can play with a soldier, and you need to use his skills in order to finish the chapter. For now, only the chapter 1 is available.

tags.balance_change: 1. Character has infinite ammo, but you still need to recharge;
2. Zombies has a lot less life;
3. Zombies dealt a lot more damage;
5. Movement is reducced by a half;
6. Grenades insta kill zombies and give damage to players;
7. Grenades bounciness and friction works different;
8. Granades and shoots damage everyone including you and NPCs;
9. Grenades has less explosion range;
10. Barricades has 190 seconds life span;

notes.title: ZPoint Update
notes.content: In addition to our update that will turn ZPlague to free, now ZPoint is not tradeable nor marketable. You now can buy it from a in-game store.

tags.feature: now ZPoint is not tradeable nor marketable. You now can buy it from a in-game store.

notes.title: ZPlague Gift Update
notes.content:
As we said earlier, we now are giving a gift for all supporters who just start the game. If you enter on the ZPlague menu you will receive all available items.
This gift will be available until 8th March, and ZPlague will turn to free in 9th March.
We hope you enjoy it, have fun!

tags.feature: - If you enter on the ZPlague menu you will receive all available items.

notes.title: ZPlague V1.1.1.0

tags.bug: - Fixed always getting ZPoints on winning if you are zombie, win match and do not die, even if do not start as zombie;
- Fixed steam inventory not showing;
- Fixed jetpack not working with low fps;

tags.feature: - Implemented counter sound on beginning of each round;

tags.balance_change: - Now recoil regenerate 2x faster;
- Reduced projectile speed, so now you can see better where your shoots go.
- Reduced jetpack fuel from 100 to 50;
- Now you only got 25 ZP for win, even with players;

notes.title: ZPlague V1.1.0.0 change notes

tags.balance_change: - Soldier reload time reduced from 5 to 4s;

tags.bug: - Fixed zombie does not move after freeze time pass;
- Fixed owning player seeing M4 equipped, even if shotgun is equipped;
- Fixed bot stop shooting after reload;

tags.feature: - Now when you win a match on the side that you start you get 50 ZP (25 if playing with bots);
- Now there is a third person reload anim;
- Changed soldier first person hands and anims;
- Now there is a first person reload anim;
- Now on shoot the recoil changes bullet location, but not camera location;
- Now bot is always with M4, independent of player equipped weapon;
- Now number of infected players is divided by 2 when playing with bots;

- Deleted all ZPoints items. Now we have only 1 item that is the 25 ZPoints and is marketable. Also, you can only drop 25 ZPoints per minute, so if the match end too soon, and you got ZPoints last match, you will not get ZPoints again.
- Changed Zombie "night vision";
- Now shoot smoke effect is disappearing faster, because it was disturbing vision;
- Now we do not have spawning items on the map, and there is 2 soldier classes. The default class is the gunner, and the engineer can be bought with ZPoints.
